title: Melting Cosmic River
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant melting stomach-like organ in the foreground spilling a winding river composed of starry blue space, brown earth, and melting clock faces. The river flows across a barren landscape toward distant mountains under a vibrant cosmic sky filled with stars, galaxies, and nebulae, with a lone olive tree on the right and paint drips throughout.
prompt: Surreal acrylic painting of a giant fleshy melting stomach organ in the foreground, spewing a winding river made of starry night sky, brown terrain, and melting Dali-style clocks that drip over the edges. The river flows through a barren desert landscape with distant orange mountains under a purple cosmic sky filled with galaxies and stars. A solitary olive tree with golden lights stands on the right. Paint drips visible on the canvas surface.
